title: Reference runner for "Models Propose, Rules Decide: An Auditable Decision Procedure for AI-Assisted Mapping"
description:
A standard-library Python implementation of the decision procedure specified in Models Propose, Rules Decide. Models propose and vote; versioned rule cards, evaluated in a fixed first-match order, decide; reviewers rule on what the cards queue. The runner executes the run graph and the policy graph over 42 synthetic units with stub models, reviewers and a curator, and fourteen checks test the procedure's claims mechanically: route coverage, termination, an 'otherwise' card ending every list, no unnamed single-source negative, zero-call replay, policy re-evaluation that re-asks only what changed, activation, publication reversal, footprint-based data recovery, challenge, per-level reporting, acceptance gates, an engine pin that refuses silent helper changes, and synthetic cost. All figures are synthetic and illustrate the arithmetic only; they are not measurements of accuracy.

Run: python3 -I check.py in this folder. Expected output is in expected/.
